correctness.rationale: Conditioning on a vertex being isolated leaves exactly B=binom(n-1,2) eligible edges, and an exterior motif placement occurs conditionally with probability (m)_e/(B)_e. Summing n-s exterior vertices gives E[UX]=(n-s) M_H q(m)_e/(B)_e with E[X]=M_H(m)_e/(N)_e and E[U]=nq, yielding exact factor Cov=EU EX[(n-s)/n (N)_e/(B)_e-1]. A motif has no isolated vertices, e<=m<=B, so interior placements cannot coexist with isolation; outside that edge-count range U or X is zero. For trees e=s-1, log[(N)_{s-1}/(B)_{s-1}]->2/alpha as n/s->alpha>1; h(x)=log(1-x)+2x has one interior root, sign negative below alpha*=1.2550009749... and positive above, excluding equality alpha*. In G(n,p), disjoint exterior-edge factors yield -s EX (1-p)^(n-1)<0 for 0<p<1. Independently exhaustively computed 36 edge-count strata across small n and path, triangle and star motifs with exact rational moments; finite enumerations corroborate the all-size counting argument.
